Are you an expert in elevator technology with a passion for troubleshooting? Do you enjoy working independently and managing your own service route? We are looking for an experienced Service Technician (Elevators) to join our professional team in the East and West Flanders regions.

About Fluves
 

Fluves is a pioneer in fiber-optic sensing, combining advanced DTS and DAS technology, real-time data processing and smart analytics to monitor and protect critical infrastructure.
 

Through its Marlinks product line, Fluves monitors more than 1,800 km of subsea power cables connecting offshore wind farms and power grids. The DALI product line detects leaks and intrusions in water networks, while Fluves Corrosion assesses the risk of corrosion under insulation in chemical plants.
 

Based in Ghent, Fluves is a growing technology scale-up active in critical infrastructure markets around the world.
 

 
 

Your role
 

As Field & Operations Technician, you will be part of the Fluves delivery team. You will support the practical and technical execution of customer projects, both on-site and from our Ghent office.
 

You will prepare, execute, verify and document the installation of fiber-optic cables and electronic equipment at locations in Belgium and neighbouring countries. You will work closely with project managers, technical experts, subcontractors and customers to ensure that delivery work is carried out safely, reliably and in accordance with Fluves’ quality standards.
 

This is a hands-on role for someone who is independent, responsible, customer-oriented and well organized.
 

 
 

What you will do
 
 

• Prepare and support fiber installations based on customer information, technical drawings and internal requirements. 

 

• Brief subcontractors before work starts, provide practical guidance during installation, and inspect and document the quality of the completed work. 

 

• Splice fiber-optic cables and repair damaged cables. 

 

• Record installed fiber routes and maintain accurate project documentation. 

 

• Prepare, test and configure equipment before shipment or installation. 

 

• Mount devices and prepare hardware for customer projects. 

 

• Prepare shipments and ensure that project materials are complete, correctly packed and properly documented. 

 

• Maintain and organize the Fluves warehouse, including equipment, tools, test setups and project materials. 

 

• Support project managers with practical technical tasks before, during and after project execution. 

 

• Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, subcontractors and colleagues. 

 

• Help ensure that installations, equipment and project documentation meet Fluves’ quality standards. 

 

• Follow all applicable safety procedures, identify and report hazards, and contribute to the continuous improvement of our working methods. 

 

• Act as Fluves’ operational lead on site and help ensure that Fluves personnel and subcontractors work in accordance with our safety and quality standards. 

Who you are
 
 

• You have a solid practical technical background, ideally through a technical bachelor’s degree, graduate degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

 

• You are hands-on and comfortable working with technical equipment, power tools, cabling, racks, sensors and electrical components. 

 

• You work carefully and have a strong eye for detail, particularly when documenting installations, inspecting work or preparing equipment for customer projects. 

 

• You have a strong safety mindset and are willing to obtain the necessary safety certificates and training. 

 

• You are responsible, reliable and well organized. When you take on a task, others can trust that you will follow it through properly. 

 

• You can work independently and adapt to unforeseen situations in the field, while knowing when to ask for support or clarification. 

 

• You communicate clearly and professionally with customers, subcontractors and colleagues. 

 

• You are comfortable working both on-site in industrial environments and in an office or warehouse environment. 

 

• You have a valid category B driving license and are willing to travel occasionally for customer projects, mainly within Belgium and neighbouring countries. 

 

• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch or French is an advantage. 

 

• You have a good working knowledge of standard office software, such as Excel, Word and Outlook, and are willing to learn to use specialized software packages. 

 

• Experience with AutoCAD or similar software is an advantage but not required. 

 

• Experience with fiber optics, electrical installations, industrial environments or applicable safety standards is an advantage but not required.

jobs.description:
Job description
 

· As the Group HSE Governance & Policy Lead you will be working closely with local HSE teams and business leaders, you will develop policies, strengthen governance, promote best practices and help create a strong safety culture throughout the organisation. 
 

· You will develop, maintain and continuously improve the Group HSE Management System; define, implement and harmonise HSE policies, standards and procedures across all business entities. 
 

· As the Group HSE Governance & Policy Lead you ensure alignment with local legislation while maintaining a common Group HSE framework, you’ll coordinate the implementation of governance processes in different regions across Europe. 
 

· You will lead corporate HSE initiatives and continuous improvement programmes, and drive the development of a proactive safety culture across the organisation. 
 

· As the Group HSE Governance & Policy Lead you will monitor changes in European and local HSE legislation and translate these into Group policies, and support senior leadership by providing strategic HSE advice and reporting.

Your profile 
 

· 
 You obtained a Master Degree in a related discipline, or equivalent by experience. 
 

· 
 You have relevant expertise with HSE Governance & Policy within an industrial, infrastructure, engineering or renewable energy environment.
 

· 
 Proven experience in developing HSE management systems, governance frameworks and corporate policies. 
 

· 
 Analytical, structured and able to translate strategy into practical policies. 
 

· 
 Strong knowledge of English, and Dutch and/or French.

Your profile

● 
 You have relevant experience in project management, preferably 
in Hydrogen, Renewable Energy or similar industries. 
 

● 
 You are passionate about Hydrogen, Renewable Energy and/or environmental technologies. 
 

●

 Excellent knowledge of English, and able to communicate in Dutch and/or French.

Job description

For a client in Duffel we are looking for a temporary 
Customer Service Representative.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• You process customer orders accurately, efficiently, and in a timely manner, while closely following up to ensure excellent customer service. 

• You respond to customer inquiries and emails and ensure smooth communication with clients. 

• You manage metal contracts and related administration. 

• You handle customer complaints in a professional and solution-oriented way. 

• You support the sales team with efficient administrative organization to guarantee continuity and high-quality customer support.  

 

Profile
 
 

• You hold at least a bachelor’s degree, preferably in a commercial or administrative field. 

• You have an excellent command of English and German. Additional languages are considered a plus. 

• You are comfortable working with Microsoft Office applications; knowledge of SAP is an advantage. 

• Experience in or affinity with an industrial environment is a strong asset. 

• You are stress-resistant and able to work efficiently under pressure. 

• You are customer-oriented, communicative, and a good listener. 

• You are proactive, persistent, and able to think creatively when solving problems.

What you will do
 

As a Supply Chain Solution Manager for Full Turn Key ASIC (application specific integrated circuit) production within imec.IC-link, you will serve as the critical interface between international customers and our ecosystem of semiconductor foundries, assembly houses, and test facilities. You take up responsibility for the full production, planning and on-time-delivery. This is a new position, to support the growing complexity of our Full Turn Key ASIC programs.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Overall planning related to wafer production, assembly, and test activities. 

• Defining the supply chain flow and managing the official handover of projects from the engineering team to the production team. 

• Monitoring production milestones and ensuring on-time delivery. 

• Aligning with the Production team lead on project status and priorities. 

• Monthly alignment with sales, account managers, and team lead on customer forecasts and subcontractor capacities. 

• Daily follow-up and update of production deliveries using IMEC’s WIP (Work-in-Progress) database system. 

• Reviewing incoming purchase orders from customers and generating corresponding purchase orders for subcontractors. 

• Coordinating global shipments to subcontractors and end customers. 

• Managing complex projects involving dynamic customer rolling forecasts and evolving subcontractor capacities. 

Who you are
 
 

• You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, or a related field. 

• You bring 5 to 8 years of experience in supply chain operations, preferably in the semiconductor, electronics, or high-tech manufacturing industry. 

• You are highly organized, accurate, and proactive, with strong skills in production planning, supplier coordination, and customer communication. 

• You are proficient in Microsoft Excel and Power BI for data analysis and reporting. 

• Diplomatic and with strong communication skills, you engage stakeholders in meeting deadlines, adhering to quality standards and achieving goals within budget. 

• You thrive in a dynamic, international environment and enjoy working closely with engineering, operations, and customer-facing teams. 

• You are fluent in English (written and spoken). Knowledge of other languages is a plus.

Bier Central Brussels is the place where beer lovers can indulge their passion.

With 
over 300 beers on the menu, warm hospitality, and a kitchen that satisfies every appetite, we’re a staple in the heart of Brussels—just a stone’s throw from 
Brussels Central Station.
 

 
 

Our passionate team is looking for a 
new colleague (Flexi) who shares our enthusiasm and energy to join our bustling establishment.
 

 
 

As a server/bartender, you are the face of our business. You ensure that every guest feels welcome and enjoys 
smooth, friendly service.
 

 
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Welcoming guests and guiding them to their table 

• Presenting the menu and providing additional explanations where necessary 

• Advising customers on their choice of food and drinks 

• Serving drinks and food 

• Clearing tables and ensuring a tidy environment 

• Helping to maintain general hygiene 

• Working in both the bar and the restaurant (no worries we’ll be happy to train you) 

We are looking for candidates who are 
willing to work hard, don’t like standing still, and are 
eager to work. 
 

 
 

-> 
Don't have that much 
experience in the hospitality industry yet? That's no problem—we'd be happy to teach you the ropes. As long as you're in 
good physical shape, there are plenty of opportunities.
 

 
 

Since we’re located in the heart of the capital, knowing a few 
languages is definitely helpful. The languages most commonly spoken here are 
Dutch, English, and French. It’s therefore no small advantage to be fluent in at least two of these languages.
 

 
 

Since closing time is around 11 p.m. to midnight, it’s convenient if you 
live nearby (i.e., within walking or biking distance, but not too dependent on public transportation—and definitely not on a car; parking in Brussels won’t make you any richer).
